easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 7 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, gaining 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Reanimate, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Grave Researcher.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's last ability any number of times, dealing infinite damage.
